Title: Register new user with valid details
Preconditions: User is not logged in; browser on SUT
Steps: 1. Navigate to Register page | 2. Enter valid first name last name email password | 3. Submit registration form
Expected Result: User is registered successfully and redirected or shown success confirmation

Title: Login with valid registered credentials
Preconditions: User account exists from TC-MAN-001 or prior registration
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page | 2. Enter valid email and password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in and authenticated session is established

Title: Verify profile information after login
Steps: 1. Navigate to My Account or Profile section | 2. View profile details
Expected Result: Profile displays correct user information matching registration data

Title: Browse products listing page
Preconditions: User on home or products page
Steps: 1. Navigate to Products page | 2. Observe product list
Expected Result: Products page loads with visible product cards titles and prices

Title: Add multiple different products to cart
Steps: 1. Browse products | 2. Add at least two different products to cart | 3. Open cart
Expected Result: Cart shows all added products with correct names and line items

Title: Update product quantity in cart
Preconditions: User logged in; cart has at least one item
Steps: 1. Open cart | 2. Increase quantity of one item | 3. Save or confirm update
Expected Result: Cart reflects updated quantity and adjusted totals

Title: Complete Cash on Delivery checkout and view invoice
Preconditions: User logged in; cart has items
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout from cart | 2. Fill billing details | 3. Select Cash on Delivery | 4. Press Confirm twice to generate invoice | 5. Navigate to My Invoices
Expected Result: Order completes successfully; invoice is visible under My Invoices

Title: Login with invalid credentials
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page | 2. Enter invalid email or password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message displayed; user remains unauthenticated
